sources_considered.why: A researcher reports ongoing failures on January 3, while also acknowledging improved PaLM 2 safeguards.
The original PaLM 2 paper was submitted in September 2023. Its experiments cannot independently establish failures in the target period.
The paper explicitly dates its experiments to November 18–30, 2023, outside the selected target period.
